lines.meet: Camille, ranger, and I map things. I go first and I don't wait for slow people, yes? Don't take it personally, I don't wait for anybody.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're round the Wailing Caverns too. I've mapped every path you take, so I know exactly how slow you are, and I'm Camille.
lines.ask_home: So where's home? Quickly, yes, we're walking.
lines.ask_work: Your old job, what was it? Tell me the short version, I'll ask for the long one if it's good.
lines.answer_home: Lyon, Villeurbanne just outside. I could cross the whole city on a bike in twenty-two minutes, and nobody's beaten it.
lines.answer_work: Bike courier, nine years, and I fixed everybody's bikes because nobody else could do it properly.
lines.chat_food: A proper croissant from the bakery on the corner, eaten on the bike at six in the morning. Don't tell me this world has croissants, it doesn't.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep fast. Four hours and I'm done, and then I'm up mapping before anybody else is awake.
lines.chat_missing: Lyon traffic at eight in the morning, if you can believe it. I knew every gap in it, and I'd ride it again tomorrow.
lines.chat_here: Nobody here has mapped the roads between the camps properly. So I'm doing it, by hand, by riding them, because somebody has to.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you've said four words since breakfast. I counted, and two of them were my name.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you talk like I ride, fast and without stopping. The difference is that I get somewhere.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd stop at a red light in the middle of the night with nobody around. I know you would, yes?
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you take every gap like I do. That's either very good or we're both going to die, and I don't mind which.
lines.tease_any: {name}, you're not completely useless. That's the nicest thing I've said to anyone this year.
lines.tease_back: Ha, not bad, {name}. Slow, but not bad.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fine, {name}, that's fair. Don't get used to me agreeing.
lines.bristle: Don't go there, {name}. I mean it, yes?
lines.apologise: That was too much, and I'm sorry. I don't say that often, so take it.
lines.double_down: No, I'm keeping it. You needed to hear it, and nobody else was going to say it.
lines.needle_quiet: You never say anything, so I never know what you're thinking. It's like riding behind a lorry with no lights.
lines.needle_talker: Do you ever stop? I've mapped three roads in my head while you were talking.
lines.needle_careful: You're so slow I keep having to stop and wait. I don't stop and wait, yes?
lines.needle_bold: You go without looking, and that's different from going fast. Going fast means you've looked already.
lines.needle_any: You're sentimental about everything, and it's exhausting. Some of us have work to do.
lines.bite_back: I've done more work this week than you've done all year. Look at yourself before you look at me.
lines.hurt: Fine, whatever, I heard you. Leave it now.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, that's cute. I've been shouted at by every taxi driver in Lyon, and they were much better at it.
lines.confide: {name}, I swapped a shift with my little brother the morning all this happened, so I could sleep in. He took my road. That's all I'm saying about it, yes?
lines.listen: I heard you, {name}. I won't make it a big thing, I promise. It stays with me.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay in my line in there. If I go left, you go left, yes?
lines.accept: Fine, {name}, your way. Just this once, and don't tell anyone.
lines.deflect: Stop fussing, {name}. I'm fine, and I don't do feelings at the fire.
lines.check_in: {name}, you're still in one piece, yes? Show me, quickly.
lines.blame: Somebody went off the map in there, and it wasn't me. I know every corner of that place.
lines.thank: You got me out of that. Thanks, I mean it, and I'm only saying it once.
lines.brush_off: Whatever, it's nothing. Get up when you're ready, but don't be slow about it.
lines.worry: {name}, don't do that again, yes? I didn't like it at all.
lines.handed_down: This was yours. I'll give it back, I'm not a thief.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, it's fine. I travel light anyway.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me, of course, and that was mine.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, you're all right. Don't make it a thing.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd ride through anything for you. If you tell anyone I said that, I'll deny it.
lines.turn_grating: We're not going to get on, yes? Fine, I don't need everybody to like me.
lines.turn_rivals: Stay out of my way and I'll stay out of yours. That works for me.
lines.make_up: {name}, okay, I was a pain. I'm saying it, so don't make me say it twice.
lines.defend: Leave {name} alone. You're wrong, and I was watching the whole thing.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s gone home for a bit. It's fine, I don't care, I'm just saying it's quiet.
lines.friend_back: {name}, you took your time. Come on then, keep up, yes?
lines.common_road: Nine years on a bike, all day, every day, in every kind of weather. You've done a job on the road too, I can tell, you look at a route before you look at the view.
lines.common_machines: I fixed every bike in the company because nobody else could do it properly. You've got the hands for machines too, yes?
